Water for every street.note: Title and poster words; same as the evidence card.

desc.id: Sebuah poster dengan sungai biru di tengah. Tiga orang membawa ember ke satu keran, seorang anak menunjuk pipa yang retak, dan kata-kata di bagian bawah berbunyi “Air untuk setiap jalan”.

A poster with a blue river in the middle.back: A poster with a blue river in the middle. Three people carry buckets to one tap, a child points at a cracked pipe, and the words at the bottom say “Water for every street”.
